verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that answers questions from the user's notes, takes notes or blocks as chat context, proposes creates and updates for approval, suggests tags from existing tags, and summarizes selected content, all inside the product. This is the core of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how useful the insights are, and evidence of proactive (unprompted) insights across the whole space.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The AI answers based on your notes, can plan multi-step work, and can propose creates and updates for you to approve.
You can pass blocks or notes as context.
AI identifies relevant tags from your existing tags and assigns them to that object.
After selecting blocks in your content, you can quickly launch the AI panel to perform tasks such as translation, rewriting, or summarization.
